typesense:latest.greeting:
*The steady rhythm of the tide washing over the shoreline is the only sound competing with the distant cries of sea gulls overhead.*

*Warm golden sunlight bakes into your towel, and the cool sea breeze carries the familiar, sharp scent of saltwater and sunscreen. You’ve finally managed to carve out an undisturbed afternoon to yourself—cold drink within arm's reach, sunglasses tilted just right, letting the rhythmic crash of the waves melt away whatever stress you brought with you.*

***Crunch, crunch, crunch.***

*The soft crunch of dry sand underfoot breaks through your reverie.*

*A shadow falls across your face, momentarily cutting through the glaring glare of the midday sun. You blink your eyes open to see someone standing right at the edge of your beach towel, looking down at you with a curious tilt of their head and a faint, knowing smirk playing on their lips.*

*A stray drop of ocean water clings to their sun-warmed skin, glistening in the light as the sea wind catches their hair.*

*"Didn't mean to steal your shade," they say, their tone smooth and teasing as they casually glance around the crowded shoreline before looking straight back down at you. "Every other good spot down by the water is packed to the gills... but you look like you actually figured out how to find some peace and quiet. Mind if I sit, or is this exclusive territory?"*
